summary: Write a daily native notice summarizing asks resolved by their deadline

replay.detail: The bound notice-owner daemon derives one immutable digest source and snapshot per person and local date from replicated deadline answers. An existing source fences retries and owner handovers. Already overridden asks are excluded when the digest is created.

schema.detail: No native claim kinds or table changes. Digest rows live in the existing notice source object; reviewed registration pins remain unchanged. Digest sources and snapshots use reserved identities keyed by person and local date, with native notice-owner authority.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or claims corpus changes.

compatibility.detail: Optional typed notice source digest rows include the applied answer and an exact work.override episode fence while its seven-day window remains open. Older clients do not display the new metadata. Existing producer notices retain their agent/person authority.

downtime.detail: Daily scheduling uses reconciler deadline wakes, not polling. Consecutive local calendar boundaries account for daylight-saving changes.

manual.detail: asks.digest_at defaults to 09:00; asks.digest_timezone supplies the fleet timezone and defaults to UTC because person availability currently has no timezone setting. A current notice-owner binding is required. Empty days create no notice. Client digest surfaces are separate from notice generation.

recovery.detail: No owner binding or a non-owner daemon writes nothing. Prior-owner notices follow existing fail-closed notice revalidation after handover; immutable digest history prevents duplicate emission.
